goal: Quantify omitted background and actual ionizing radiation feedback on original represented IGM abundance histories
primary_inputs: Exact original history.csv bytes under each CASE; SHA-256 pins in full_history_diagnostic.PINS

conventions.time: elapsed gas proper seconds from each zbar20 surface
conventions.units: SI in new derived products; input n in cm^-3 and photon energy eV/H converted explicitly
conventions.J2: sum photon_stock_per_H times E_eV times P2(local_mu), no factor 5 or additional angular weights

numerical_comparison_scope: actual saved-history node maxima and perturbative quadrature; no original evolution error estimate
remaining: coupled response if requested by the owner after complete approximation assessment

drift_watchdog.concrete_contribution: consumes actual native ionizing J2 and thermal states, finishes missing saved-history stress integrals and evaluates original thresholds
drift_watchdog.stop_after: independent review and integration; no new radiation atlas or new coupled model
